description: This file defines a static internal class 'IsExternalInit' within the 'System.Runtime.CompilerServices' namespace. It is used to support record serialization for older or downlevel frameworks where the 'init' accessor is not supported natively.

classes.name: IsExternalInit
classes.description: A static internal class used as a marker for enabling 'init'-only properties in earlier versions of C#/.NET where such features are not natively supported.
